goal: Improve the formal kernel.py entrypoint for real TP=1 G11 packed-NVFP4 MoE toward beating flashinfer.trtllm_fp4_block_scale_moe.

kernel.py: Added an exact G11 TP=1 staged BMM fast path behind FUSED_MOE_TASK08_STAGED=auto.

The fast path is enabled only for T=9500, H=4096, I=1024, E=512, top_k=10, routing_method_type=1, packed uint8 hidden_states [9500,2048], fp8 hidden_states_scale [9500,256], and FlashInfer prepared weight shapes.

The fast path reuses repo task08 generated GEMM1/GEMM2 BMM helpers, routes with routing_pack_type1, builds routing metadata, packs hidden activations/scales, runs prepared-layout SwiGLU NVFP4 requant, then final_scatter_from_bmm.
The first exact-G11 fast-path call discards one candidate warmup to avoid the task08 cold-launch correctness issue recorded in v25.
If the task08 helper probe files or external task08 root are unavailable, kernel.py falls back to the previous scalar CUDA path.

improvement_vs_previous_scalar.note: The formal entrypoint improved from hundreds of milliseconds to about 2.85 ms, but remains about 2.0x slower than FlashInfer.

formal_g11_warpshuffle_postldsync_postsy.conclusion: Do not make the diagnostic warp-shuffle GEMM2 symbol the kernel.py default. It can pass the standalone end-to-end probe with warmup but failed under the formal evaluator integration.

recommended_next_steps: Keep clean postsync as the default kernel.py staged BMM GEMM2 symbol.
Reduce remaining 2x gap by eliminating staged memory traffic: fuse GEMM2 output with final scatter and/or fuse SwiGLU requant into GEMM2 input consumption.
If revisiting diagnostic GEMM2 symbols, debug under kernel.py/test_kernel.py formal evaluator, not only probe_task08_end_to_end.py.
Avoid cache or precomputed-output shortcuts; the fast path still computes the MoE output with own kernels.

quality_gate.reason: The formal kernel.py entrypoint is now correct and about 239x faster than the previous scalar G11 path, but it still does not beat flashinfer.trtllm_fp4_block_scale_moe.
